params.caption: 🕹️ Take-Two boss: physical games will never fully vanish, but will be tiny Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told The Game Business there will "always be some physical business" in games, but only as a very small part of the market. He compared it to vinyl in music, as streaming dominates. The comments land as Sony plans to end PlayStation discs in 2028. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 23:12 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames · @PlayStation 💿 Team disc or team digital? React and tell us why 💬 #TakeTwo #GTA6 #PhysicalGames #GamingNews
